# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 29 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** The Oil of Mercy Is Promised for the Future

---

**29:1** And Michael said to Seth: 'The oil of mercy shall not come to you now, for many generations must pass before the time of the Son of God.'

**29:2** 'But when he comes, he will raise up all the righteous, and he will give to them the oil of mercy for eternal life.'

**29:3** And Seth received these words in his heart and told them to his father Adam.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
